## 📋 Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
<!-- Provide a clear, concise summary of the changes made and the problem being solved. -->

### Type of Change
- [ ] 🚀 New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update (README, ARCHITECTURE, FAQ, docs/API.md, or in-app docs)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring (no functional changes, modular code improvements)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (adding new tests or fixing existing tests)

## 🛡️ Contributor Checklist

Please confirm that your PR satisfies all project standards:

- [ ] **Branching Rules Followed**: Branch is created off `main` and named appropriately (e.g. `feat/...`, `fix/...`, `docs/...`).
- [ ] **Conventional Commits**: Commit messages follow the `type: description` convention.
- [ ] **Zero 3rd-Party Dependencies**: No `pip install` packages or npm dependencies have been added to the project.
- [ ] **Python Standard Library Only**: Relies 100% on the Python 3 standard library.
- [ ] **CI & Local Tests Pass**: Ran `python3 app.py --cli --min-hp 70` without failures.
- [ ] **Living Documentation Synchronized**: Updated `README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `FAQ.md`, `docs/API.md`, and in-app docs if applicable.
